title: Chilli Garlic Crisp Fried Egg
method: Serve with a slice of toast or even over a bed of steamed rice
caption:
Chilli Garlic Crisp Fried Egg
breakfast diaries | under 300 calories 

Nutrition: 
C: 4 | F: 14 | P: 14
Calories: 204 per serving without bread
Serves 1

Ingredients
1 tsp garlic chilli crisp 
1/2 tsp sesame seeds
2 eggs
salt + pepper as needed
1 stalk spring onion greens, chopped

serve with a slice of toast or even over a bed of steamed rice
